title: ASF-Notifier
description: Sends ASF notifications to a Matrix room.

Enabled.title: Enabled
Enabled.description: false disables every notification. Default: true.

HomeserverUrl.title: Homeserver URL
HomeserverUrl.description: Base URL of the Matrix homeserver, for example https://matrix.example.org.

RoomId.title: Room ID
RoomId.description: Room ID starting with '!', not an alias.

AccessToken.title: Access token
AccessToken.description: Matrix access token. The environment variable ASF_NOTIFIER_MATRIX_ACCESS_TOKEN wins when it is set and non-empty; prefer it, because this value is stored in plain text.

CommandRoomId.title: Command room ID
CommandRoomId.description: Room the commands are read in. Defaults to RoomId.

DisconnectedNotifyAfterMinutes.title: Disconnected notify after (minutes)
DisconnectedNotifyAfterMinutes.description: Minutes a bot stays disconnected before a BotDisconnected notification is sent.

Events.title: Events
Events.description: Turn single event kinds on or off. A kind that is not listed keeps the plugin default.

BotStoppedByAsf.title: BotStoppedByAsf
BotStoppedByAsf.description: ASF stopped a bot, for example after a login failure.

BotStopped.title: BotStopped
BotStopped.description: A bot was stopped by hand or by a command.

BotDisconnected.title: BotDisconnected
BotDisconnected.description: A bot stayed disconnected for DisconnectedNotifyAfterMinutes.

BotReconnected.title: BotReconnected
BotReconnected.description: A bot reconnected after a disconnected notification.

AsfError.title: AsfError
AsfError.description: ASF or a bot logged an error.

Enabled.title: Enabled
Enabled.description: false disables the notifications of this bot. Default: true.

Events.title: Events
Events.description: Per-bot overrides of the global Events. A kind that is not listed inherits the global value.

BotStoppedByAsf.title: BotStoppedByAsf
BotStoppedByAsf.description: ASF stopped this bot, for example after a login failure.

BotStopped.title: BotStopped
BotStopped.description: This bot was stopped by hand or by a command.

BotDisconnected.title: BotDisconnected
BotDisconnected.description: This bot stayed disconnected for DisconnectedNotifyAfterMinutes.

BotReconnected.title: BotReconnected
BotReconnected.description: This bot reconnected after a disconnected notification.
